title: List books with default pagination (200)

title: Create book with valid data (201)
description: Happy path: POST /books creates a resource. Cleanup: DELETE the created book.
preconditions: Acquire a Bearer token (see login flow) and store it as <TOKEN>
steps: POST /books with headers {Content-Type: application/json, Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>} and body {"title":"Test Book","author":"Author","price":9.99}
Capture created id from response.body.id as <NEW_BOOK_ID>
expected_results: response.body.id is present and is an integer
